title: Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource & Pacing Advisory
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource and Pacing Advisory over the MAS-01..09 foundations while preserving canonical Encounter/combat/challenge/resource/runtime owner authority and keeping advisory planning distinct from live resolution or mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource and Pacing Advisory inside the MAS workspace without turning advisory composition into canonical encounter state, live challenge resolution, resource mutation or runtime outcome truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically produce prepared encounter/challenge/resource/pacing advisory over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating advisory planning as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized or required.
MAS-01 through MAS-09 remain completed foundations and are not reopened silently.

Advisory references or suggested pacing never prove an encounter occurred, a challenge resolved, resources changed or runtime outcomes became true.
Detailed MAS-10 owner/runtime seams are loaded only inside this tranche and unresolved references fail closed.
MAS-11 retains Location, Map, Route & Scene Binding scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-11+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, load only MAS-09 plus targeted Encounter/combat/challenge/resource/runtime owner seams, establish causal MAS-10 RED, then implement the minimum deterministic prepared advisory contract without pulling MAS-11 location/map binding forward.
